info.name: LLM Model Failover — E2E
info.description: Live e2e verification of the LLM model-failover policy against a real gateway-controller + gateway-runtime stack, with two mock LLM backends (mock-openai, mock-anthropic). See gateway/dev-policies/FAILOVER_TESTING.md for setup. Disable SSL certificate verification before running (gateway-runtime uses a self-signed cert on :8443).
